0022600107.text: Houston is 2-0 and sits 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, and it is 1-0 on the road so far, while Atlanta, also 2-0, is 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East. For the Rockets, Fred VanVleet, Reed Sheppard, and Steven Adams are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, with VanVleet and Adams out for rest and Sheppard dealing with a knee bruise. The Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, but Houston won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
